acceptance_predicates.description: Development recording captures are explicitly selected, redacted, sealed, and content-addressed without credentials or raw responses.
Selected and all-agent recording campaigns publish exact complete coverage and reject incomplete, duplicate, or mismatched entries.
A valid sealed cassette replays with runtime-owned local/mock authority, network denied, and no provider fallback.
Recorded and replayed runs produce bounded reports and a comparison result from matching identities.
Receipts expose only opaque identities and typed diagnostics; credentials, prompts, responses, and private paths are absent.

definition_of_done: Exact current ASB main focused recording, replay, comparison, and campaign tests pass.
Development qualification uses local/mock authority and does not require provider traffic or a GitHub Reviews API approval object.

inputs.description: Deterministic bounded local/mock capture and workload selection.

outputs.description: Privacy-safe qualification receipt bound to the exact product main commit.

gates.description: Offline replay and comparison fail closed if the provider network is reachable or an identity mismatches.
